pages.name: About
pages.seoDescription: The materials, makers and thinking behind Fernwood Goods — a simpler, better-made everyday, built to last and gentle at the end.

children.class: mx-auto flex w-full max-w-3xl flex-col gap-6

children: Fernwood Goods is a small shop of everyday housewares — the towels, jars, brushes, baskets and bowls a home runs on — made from materials the earth makes more of. We started it because the ordinary things in most kitchens are quietly made of plastic and built to be thrown away, and we thought the useful stuff could be honest stuff instead.

So every item here earns its place twice: it has to work as well as the thing it replaces, and it has to be made from something you can name — cotton, linen, wood, glass, beeswax, stone. We tell you what each thing is made of, where it came from, and how to keep it going for years. That is the whole idea: everyday things, honestly made.
